mentions.name: Aphorio
mentions.description: A task manager for Linux designed to be more informative and resource efficient than the Windows Task Manager. It provides an informative dashboard for Docker containers and web servers, with proxy support and a preference for streaming sockets supporting HTTP and web sockets over the same ports.
mentions.problem: The Windows Task Manager is less informative and less resource efficient, and it does not work on Linux.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a task manager that’s way more informative and resource efficient than the windows task manager and works on Linux. It also provides an informative dashboard for docker containers and web servers with proxy support and preference for streaming sockets supporting http and web sockets over the same ports.
